title: Fixed Twin Tower Cable Suspension Footbridge
description: One newly authored complete static twin-tower suspension footbridge appearance. Two full portal towers rise from thick grounded end piers. Two continuous anchor-to-anchor cables pass over the tower tops and sag through the central span, with complete vertical hangers descending to two continuous deck-edge stringers and one full transverse-planked walking deck. Four whole outer cable-anchor blocks and two separate straight low side rails complete this one prop. This is neither a shallow arched timber-stringer bridge nor a raised gateway bridge leaf with lifting ropes: the complete central deck hangs below a continuous over-tower primary cable route. All geometry newly drawn; no old bridge mesh or scenic terrain imported. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and actual horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One model, zero scenes. No water, ravine, approach road or people. Fixed stylized display only; no cable equilibrium, structural analysis, anchor design, bridge installation, modular fit, traversability, load, fall protection, manufacture or engineering/safety claim.
